full_judgment: land of C.S. Khatian No. 418 corresponding to S.A. Khatian No. 414 under the landlord Nagendrananth Basu. She died leaving behind four sons namely Abinash, Lolit, Sarat Chandra and Monilal Bhattacharjee. Binoy Kumar and Vagaboti together filed Title Suit No. 762 of 1969 in respect of the Suit land in which process was duly served upon the defendants. Asgar Ali Fakir in need of cash money sold the suit land to this defendant vide Kabala No. 812 dated 18.04.1994 and delivered possession thereof.
